description: Source code for a Git credential helper using libsecret to store and retrieve credentials from the GNOME Keyring, including functions for managing credentials, interfacing with the Secret Service API, and command-line operation handling.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for credential fields and reinitializes the credential struct.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin, parsing key-value pairs into a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Outputs credential data (username, password, etc.) to stdout.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line interface.
